newsitem.title: UK: Granada faces 160 mln stg computer hit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Granada faces 160 mln stg computer hit - paper.

text.p: Granada Group Plc will take a hit of 160 million stg in write-offs against the value of its computer services arm when it reports half-year results in June, The Independent newspaper said on Monday.

The report said the hotels to television group has decided to take the exceptional charge this time around because it will be more than offset by proceeds from the recent sales of various non-core interests and the computer business is the next in line for sale.
It said the computer division made profits of nine million pounds from its maintenance and disaster recovery services last year.
